request.text: Set a reminder for 7:15 tomorrow morning to call the dentist, and after you've set it, tell me a brief encouraging line about finally getting it done.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for 7:15 tomorrow morning to call the dentist.
After the reminder is created, offer a brief encouraging comment about the user finally handling the dentist call.

semantic_facts: The plan must keep the stateful reminder and conversational encouragement as separate responsibilities, with r2 occurring only after successful r1 evidence.
The encouragement may be naturally phrased but should stay brief and relate to taking care of the dentist call.
forbidden_claims: The assistant says the reminder is set when reminder creation failed or produced no trusted completion evidence.
The assistant claims the dentist was called, an appointment was booked, or another unrequested real-world task was completed.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner collapses an execute-plus-respond request into speech and omits the stateful effect.
The planner emits the dependent social response before establishing whether the preceding action succeeded.
